capabilities: Render all Google calendars in a gcal code block or sidebar pane with month, week, day and list views
Create, edit, move, resize and delete Google Calendar events from Obsidian
Mirror task notes per project folder to Google Tasks lists, syncing title, due date and completion both ways
Share an encrypted Google login across devices through vault sync so mobile needs no login
Expose an API that opens the calendar's event modal from scripts and other plugins
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The user must create their own Google Cloud OAuth client, so no third-party server is involved; detailed setup, architecture and troubleshooting docs live outside the README. Client ID and secret are stored in plain text in data.json, and the refresh token is encrypted with a user-chosen passphrase; a login from before 1.2.0 stays in plain text until a passphrase is set. Desktop login only; mobile unlocks the shared token.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view and edit Google Calendar events inside notes, or to keep task notes in sync with Google Tasks across devices.

relations.evidence: A gcal code block that turns into your Google Calendar (all calendars, month/week/day, create/edit/drag/delete)
plus task notes mirrored to Google Tasks so they show up as checkboxes in the Google Calendar app

requires.name: Own Google Cloud OAuth client (Client ID and Client secret)

summary: Google Calendar integration that renders an editable calendar in a gcal code block or a sidebar pane and mirrors task notes to Google Tasks.
